subject: Request: Senior approval for Hosted API concession (22% off) - MedCrest Labs
messages:
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Elaine Yang <elaine.yang@medcrest.com>, procurement@medcrest.com
Date: 2028-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal and ask: Hosted API list + concession request (MedCrest)

Ben / Jonas — looping you both on a request from MedCrest. Elaine and procurement are evaluating a 12-month production rollout (hosted API) across multiple teams. Current list pricing puts their run-rate just above their budget. They are asking for a 22% unit discount on Hosted API usage for the first 12 months in exchange for a 12-month minimum committed spend and a prepay of the first quarter.

Why this matters:
- ARR upside: estimated incremental TCV ~ $680k over 12 months if we secure the commit (see forecast).
- Strategic: MedCrest is a referenceable biopharma target with multi-region plans — potential Dedicated opportunity in 2029.
- Timing: procurement needs a signed SOW and concession authorization by end of week to meet their board procurement window.

Attachments: MedCrest_Month1_forecast.xlsx, SOW_MedCrest_v1.pdf, pricing-impact-summary.csv

Ask: Can we get senior signoff for a 22% off-hosted API unit concession (non-standard >20%) with the following constraints: 1) 12-month minimum; 2) prepay Q1 (credits applied to account); 3) review of usage and retention after 90 days with right to revert to standard rates if usage < 60% of forecast.

If you want, I can prepare a short Exec memo (1 page) for Marissa. Elaine — happy to jump on quick call to align on commitment structure.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposal and ask: Hosted API concession (MedCrest) — numbers and risk

Marissa — forwarding Karthik's ask. Quick summary from finance modeling:
- Baseline list revenue: $870,000 over 12 months.
- With 22% concession and prepay as structured, net recognized revenue ~ $678,600; cash flow up front helps Q3.
- Upside: cross-sell probability to Dedicated/Private in 18–24 months ~ 25% (qualitative).
- Risk: if usage undershoots forecast by >40% at 90-day review, net margin compresses materially.

Suggested guardrails: attach a 90-day usage review with a revenue clawback clause (pro-rated), require procurement sign-off on prepay terms in SOW, and require legal to approve special rate code.

If you want an Exec memo, Karthik has the forecast attached — I can draft the 1‑pager with recommended approval language.

-Ben
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal and ask: Hosted API concession (MedCrest)

Thanks — I reviewed the forecast and the quick P&L Ben ran. I am willing to approve a 22% concession for the Hosted API usage but only under firm conditions. To shortcut back-and-forth: I need the following before I sign off: 

1) Prepay/commit language in SOW (first quarter invoiced and collected prior to launch).
2) 90-day usage review with a pro-rated clawback to recover difference if usage < 60% of forecast (simple formula in SOW).
3) Payments and special rate code must be routed through Finance; include the Billing contact in the DocuSign envelope.
4) Legal to confirm the SOW redlines (procurement has indicated they can accept limited clawbacks).

Karthik — please prepare a one-page Exec memo that includes: forecast vs. plan, incremental CAC/implementation effort, and the proposed SOW language for the three items above. Jonas — please validate there are no capacity/ops flags for onboarding in August if we sign. I will aim to respond within 24hrs after I see that memo and the signed prepay term in a draft SOW.

If all checks out, I can authorize the 22% concession and will copy Finance to create the special rate code.

-Marissa
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Elaine Yang <elaine.yang@medcrest.com>, procurement@medcrest.com
Date: 2028-07-02T13:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal and ask: Hosted API concession (MedCrest) — Exec memo and SOW draft

Marissa — attached is the one-page Exec memo (included inline below) and a draft SOW with the prepay and 90-day clawback language highlighted. Elaine — sharing so you have visibility; hope this reflects the procurement terms we discussed.

--- Exec memo (summary) ---
- Forecasted usage (monthly tokens) attached; expected ramp to steady-state by month 3.
- Financials: 22% concession reduces unit price resulting in projected recognized revenue $678.6k; cash collected Q1 improves cash profile.
- Ask: Senior approval for 22% off list for 12 months conditional on prepay Q1 and 90-day usage review.
- Recommend approval with clawback: if usage across first 90 days < 60% of forecast, customer pays back pro-rated difference for the shortfall.

Attachments referenced earlier: SOW_MedCrest_v1.pdf (redlines included), MedCrest_Month1_forecast.xlsx, pricing-impact-summary.csv

DocuSign link for draft SOW: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abc123-signature
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/DL-7812

Karthik
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Elaine Yang <elaine.yang@medcrest.com>, procurement@medcrest.com
Date: 2028-07-03T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal and ask: Hosted API concession (MedCrest) — Approved with conditions

Karthik / Ben / Jonas — I have reviewed the memo, the SOW redlines, and the billing/finance checklist. I will approve the 22% Hosted API concession for MedCrest Labs under the exact conditions below: 

1) Signed SOW with explicit prepayment of Q1 prior to go-live (DocuSign envelope must include finance billing email for collection).
2) 90-day usage review with pro-rated clawback if usage < 60% of forecast; formula must be explicit in SOW.
3) Legal to sign off on SOW redlines (Karthik, please confirm legal engagement).
4) Approval expires if not executed (DocuSign completed and funds collected) by 2028-07-10 EOD; after that, this special rate offer is null.

Elaine — once we have the signed SOW and the prepay cleared, I will ask Finance to create a special rate code and ensure reporting in the Console for per-route token usage. Thanks for moving quickly here.

Marissa
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
